reviews.text:
We took Mahou to the vet for the first time today, and Eva couldn't have treated him better; he even fell asleep!

Thank you so much, Eva, for your wonderful care of the patients and their families ❤️ You're definitely going to be our vet!

We are deeply grateful to fate for bringing Eva into our lives. We arrived in Madrid as immigrants with an elderly dog ​​of almost 16 years. Eva ensured that she lived her last months happily and without pain, and lovingly accompanied us through the process of saying goodbye. We are still moved and incredibly grateful for her comfort, her listening ear, and her respectful and loving guidance. We will return to Eva when we adopt another furry friend! 🐶♥️

Eva is a fantastic professional and has a wonderful personality. I've been taking my dog ​​Rumba to her for over 11 years, and she's absolutely thrilled every time. I recommend her to everyone I know who has a dog or cat.
The trusted veterinarian. She's wonderful with Rita, who, despite being a little wary, is very comfortable with her.
Eva is an excellent veterinarian, caring and a wonderful person. My little Frida couldn't be in better hands. Thank you for always treating her with such love and professionalism.
Eva is a fantastic veterinarian. From the very first moment, it's clear she wants the best for our pets and has extensive veterinary knowledge. Thank you so much, Eva!
Eva is the best vet I've found. She's far from my house, but I still prefer to take my furry little guy there rather than to another vet near my home.

A very kind, polite, and detail-oriented person who loves her job and animals.
She's very flexible and accommodating with her schedule.
We get along great :)
I recommend her.
Thank you for taking the time to rate us so positively, Lovina Victoria.

It's a very welcoming, clean, and pleasant-smelling clinic. I took my dogs to get vaccinated. The treatment was excellent, and the dogs were delighted. We'll be back in September for their next vaccination, and the clinic already has new clients. Thank you for everything.
If you need anything for your pet, don't hesitate to take them to Neva Clinic. The care Eva gives pets is incredible. You have to go. The animals feel right at home. Happy.
